projects.title: Self Balancing Robot
projects.description: Use feedback controls to develop a self balancing robot. The physics of the robot are simple, the robot stands on two wheels and when it tends to fall and lose its vertical position, the movement of the wheel in the direction of the falling rises the robot to recover the vertical standing position. Using an Arduino, a motor driver, an inertial measuring unit, and 3D printed materials, the team developed a standard PID controller for the project.
